name: Mary
summary: A woman of Bethany, sister of Martha and Lazarus, who loved to sit and listen to Jesus. Before His death she poured costly ointment on His feet and dried them with her hair.

key_moments.title: Sitting at Jesus' Feet
key_moments.description: While her sister Martha was busy serving, Mary sat down at Jesus' feet and listened to what He said. Jesus told Martha that Mary had chosen the good part, and it would not be taken from her.

key_moments.title: Weeping for Her Brother
key_moments.description: After Lazarus died, Martha quietly told Mary that Jesus had come and was asking for her. Mary hurried to Him, fell weeping at His feet, and said her brother would not have died if He had been there.

key_moments.title: Anointing Jesus' Feet
key_moments.description: At a supper in Bethany, Mary poured a pound of costly ointment on Jesus' feet and dried them with her hair, and its smell filled the house. When Judas complained, Jesus said to leave her alone, for she had kept it for the day of His burial.
